_note: Mechanism: unspoken rule. The domestic standoff where nobody will be the one to act, and the object outlasts everyone's patience.

premise.situation: Nobody in the flat will empty the washing machine because whoever empties it has to fold it
premise.turn: The clothes have been in there long enough that they now have to be washed again
premise.detail: somebody put a towel on top of it, which counts as dealing with it

character_sheet: a woman in her twenties, hair tied back, hoodie, standing in a small utility room

beats.text: There is a load of washing in our machine from Sunday.
It finished. We all heard it finish. The beeping went on for a while.
Nobody will open it, because whoever opens it has to fold it.
That is the rule. Nobody made the rule. The rule is simply there.
Someone put a clean towel on top of the machine. As a gesture.
It is now Thursday, and the washing has developed an opinion.
So we are going to wash it again. That is the plan.
